sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Golden Swag is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Alright, you little criminal! I've got this one bloke who didn't like my terms and tried to get smart with me. I put him in his place once, but now he's gotten far too cocky. Time to teach him a lesson. Simple job. There's a group of Scavs holed up at the Factory. One of their top dogs is some bloke called Uruguay. What a bloody stupid nickname! Best put an end to his little adventure. But that's only half the job. He's got a supposedly lucky gold-plated Zibbo, he keeps fiddling with it all the time. Even came by my place, couldn't stop clicking the fucking thing. Bring it to me. Alright, rere's the plan... Stop by the dorms, get inside this fucker's room 303, grab the golden Zibbo and stash a regular Zibbo in its place. Got it? Write it down if you need to. Now get out there and get to work!"

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Locate and obtain the Golden Zibbo lighter from Dorm room 303 on Customs
- Stash a regular Zibbo at Dorm room 303 on Customs
- Hand over the Golden Zibbo lighter

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- 3,000 EXP
- Skier Rep +0.1
- 450 Euros
  - 473 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 518 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 2
- 2× Pack of screws
"Proper good job. Let's see what comes of it. You go get some rest, yeah?"

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid | Notes |
| Dorm room 303 key | 1 | Required | N/A | Unlocks dorm room 303 in the three-story dorms on Customs where the Golden Zibbo lighter is located. |
| Golden Zibbo lighter | 1 | Required | Yes | This quest item can only be found if the quest is active.; When picked up, this item is transferred to the player's quest item inventory.; If the player fails to extract with this item, they will lose it. |
| Zibbo lighter | 1 | Required | N/A | Stashed item |
In this quest you first have to find a golden Zibbo lighter on Customs. It can be found on a desk in room 303 on the third floor of the three-story dorms building. A Dorm room 303 key is required to enter it. Afterwards a Zibbo lighter has to be stashed in the same location.
